treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — grid reliability (SAIDI/SAIFI) using SCADA and outage management system. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — grid reliability (SAIDI/SAIFI) measured monthly. Target: SAIDI below 90 minutes. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against IEEE 1366 reliability benchmarks. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — grid reliability (SAIDI/SAIFI) trending toward SAIDI below 60 min. Escalate if <SAIDI below 120 min. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using IEEE 1366 framework. treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 180 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >30 consecutive days, escalate to a nuclear safety and licensing specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign.
